steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: That Orchid lady sure is weird.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: *sigh* Whatever.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Time to get back to research—

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Damn, this guy's quick! My launcher's no good against him!)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Is that all mew've got?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Don't get cocky just yet, little cloudbeast!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'll get Popukar outta here, or die trying!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I don't know what's going on in your head, but if mew interrupt the ritual, you'll actually be hurting Her Meowjesty!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And why should I believe you?! Is that why you're making her suffer like this?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I'm not lying!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It's the entire reason we have to take out the meownsters!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What kind of excuse is that?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Drat, almost out of ammo. I need to find a better weapon—)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Wait, over there...)
Catapult spots a sword and shield lying in the corner of the workshop.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hey! Don't touch other people's weapons!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sorry, Suponosuke, just borrowing these for a bit!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Thinking of using a charge blade against me? Get ready to lose one of your lives—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I might've given up on becoming a knight because I hate how they do things...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But I've still trained with this sort of thing.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: C'mon, cloudbeast, it's time for round two!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (There are... fewer guards than I expected.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This is an Escorchgot's shell?
She takes a fist-sized chunk of the shining dark red crystal from the giant shell.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (It feels completely different.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (I don't sense any Originium Arts conductivity either... What even is this?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Is this really just an ordinary rock?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (But how? How can this place have no Originium at all?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (What's that shaking?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (What the?!)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How can something dead just—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: What's going on here?!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (This is bad! My Arts unit's kaput, and there's nowhere to hide!)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (This black gas... Can it revive things with that 'curse'?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (If I let this thing out of here, it'll wreak havoc. I need to find a way to stall it—)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Are there any weapons I can use here?)
Orchid looks around, immediately noticing the fallen guard's bow.
As a caster, she often has to deal with situations where she is unable use arts: Arts unit failures, high Originium concentrations, and so on.
As such, Rhodes Island offers casters training courses in backup weapons. Naturally, the cautious Orchid has already completed several of them.
And one of them was on using a bow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (No time for hesitation!)
She rolls away from the Escorchgot's attack, snatching the bow from the unconscious guard's hand.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (It's lighter than a Rhodes Island standard-issue. I can use it!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Man, you're short, but you're a beast on the offense...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Is there a purr-oblem? Didn't you say you could use a charge blade?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This thing's clunkier than I thought it'd be!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Its weight means you can't dodge freely! And if mew only focus on defense—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You'll soon be in a pinch!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Charge blades are weapons that purr-vide both offense and defense! When you're being attacked, you need to strike back!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Aren't you my enemy?! What's with the training course?!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I can't stand watching mew waste its power! Don't just swing it around!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeah, sure, thanks.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (He keeps calling it a 'charge blade', but isn't it just an ordinary sword and shield?)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Wait, the shield's got a slot in it... and it kinda looks like... an axe head... I got it!)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: No matter! It's time to end this farce!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Don't call it just yet!
As Masamune attacks, Catapult lowers her guard, instead inserting her sword into the shield's slot. The mechanism within activates, uniting the two into a giant axe.
Masamune's strike reaches her at the precise moment she morphs her weapon, but it has no chance of interrupting her swing. And it just so happens to bring him into axe range—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hup!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, I get it now! You can combine the sword and shield into an axe!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: (She didn't notice, but she blocked my attack the moment she morphed the charge blade...)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: (She's got pawtential.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Check out my—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Geh, that's heavy!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: But she's too reliant on intuition.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Sheathe thy blade, Sir Masamune. She is no villain. She hath simply misunderstood the situation.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: As Your Meowjesty commands.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hofukaru!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Catapult, what thou sawest doing earlier was how I purify the curse. This is a duty that has been passed down through generations of miko. I need not be saved from it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Screw duty! Look at yourself! You're just a kid! You don't even know what you're doing!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I do know.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I gather that one of thy companions hath both a name and a countenance similar to mine own. This is the source of thy misunderstanding.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But I am not the Popukar thou knowest.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I don't buy it!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hast thou any proof?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Popukar's got Originium crystals on her arm!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yours must too—
Hofukaru silently rolls up her sleeves. Catapult stares in shock.
Hofukaru's arms are white as jade, without so much as a blemish.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Hah... Hah... Just barely managed to hit it... But that one arrow used up nearly all my strength.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (This is bad. I'll exhaust myself before I can take that thing out.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Crap—

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: To think the curse has reached the stage where it can even revive beasts... No, this is no revivification, but rather the curse spurring them onwards.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: Attendant.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Shogun.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: Clear away this corpse.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Shall I inform Her Majesty of this matter?

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: Her Majesty must focus on the trial.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: Madam Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're Mid...night, correct?

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: I must thank you. Had you not delayed it, I fear this Escorchgot would have caused significant casualties.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're not going to ask why I'm here?

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: Her Majesty is still far too rash.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: She believed that placating you would be enough, but never expected that this would only lead to misunderstandings.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: I came here to offer the both of you an apology in her stead.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...I've got a question.

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: You may ask.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is your name really Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight?
steps.text: Ever since the day I was born.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (...I didn't think seeing that face actually being serious for once would be so damaging to my psyche.)

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: While Her Majesty's recklessness may have given rise to your doubts, you in turn have caused us some trouble. Let us consider the scales even.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult, she—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: She clashed with a former Iju Hunter, but they have already resolved their conflict.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Catapult.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It would seem your colleague has arrived.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, I... I don't think they're putting on an act. Hofukaru really does think she's on a mission.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And there's no sign of any Originium crystals on her.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I know. Suponosuke didn't have any on him either.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This place really has no Originium. We can't rely on our common sense here.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So... does that mean we aren't on Terra anymore? And that these three really aren't our three?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Then we need to get back, ASAP!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Hofukaru told us how to get back from the start. We just never believed her.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I've been assuming this was all some kind of trick, but it looks like we have to face reality.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: In regards to the trial, the hunt, and Her Majesty... I have a humble request, if I may.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: As it happens, I've got my own questions for you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Follow me, then.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I am sure you both have many questions.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Not me.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: There's loads of hunting weapons here. Can I try them out?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*... Why do you not want Hofukaru to go after the Lord of Thunder?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I've got two guesses.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: First, you wanted to use the failure of the previous lord to reform the state, weakening the lord's influence and moving power into your own hands.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Catapult Style: Dividing Slash!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ha, that's Orchid for you. Didn't think you'd dodge my strike after I put everything into it—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, that hurt!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Go play over there.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Fiiine.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And your second guess?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're trying to avoid pointless casualties, and don't want her to throw her life away.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And which do you believe now?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I believe it can be both. They aren't mutually exclusive.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Because you're not like the average power-hungry politician, nor are you simply an overprotective guardian.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: May I take that as a compliment?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'd prefer an answer.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Is this a horn? Let's see, where do I blow into it—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Inhales)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Blows)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oops, sorry. Did I bother you guys?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Give it up, Catapult. You've got no talent for woodwinds.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Everything began with the previous lord's disappearance.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: She was skilled, and ruled the nation well. Houei flourished during her reign.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: She was also strong, completing three trials in her time.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: All knew that the next few decades would see unprecedented peace and prosperity. I was happy to dedicate my life to assisting her.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But then she disappeared during the last Iju hunt, and all her responsibilities fell onto the shoulders of the young Lady Hofukaru.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What happened to the former lord, exactly?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...I cannot tell you, for she vanished right before our eyes.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That was ten years ago.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Missing for ten years... That's as good as dead.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Which is why Houei cannot afford to lose Her Majesty.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Only the miko can dispel the curse. If Her Majesty passes away during a hunt, Houei will be truly doomed.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Which is why you'd prefer to let the Lord of Thunder wreak havoc for another decade, and why you stopped your lord from challenging it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You do realize this will only make her blame herself even more, don't you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The former lord's disappearance led to many changes, Madam Orchid.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What you, the current generation of Iju Hunters, must do is simple.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You need only complete your trial, then return home.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: In other words, you're hoping that Catapult and I will accept the trial, but if Hofukaru wants us to go challenge the Lord of Thunder too, you want us to refuse.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I believe you will make the wise choice.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wow, this lance is heavy! Looks like it's called a 'gunlance'? Does that mean it can fire bullets?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hmm... Ah, I think I get it. You press this to fire?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Midnight, I've come to fetch the new Iju Hunters.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: There are still plenty of things to teach... them?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Meow?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Here goes.
The shell screams as it skims over the little 'cloudbeast's' head, exploding in midair outside the palace.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err, guess this weapon doesn't suit me... Haha... Ha...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Me-oww...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: CA-TA-PULT!
